newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Eleven register for Venezuela's Sidor sale.
newsitem.headline: Eleven register for Venezuela's Sidor sale.

text.p: The Venezuelan Investment Fund announced on Thursday that 11 groups of investors had registered to participate in the sale of steel company Sidor, a controlling stake in which is to be sold early next year.
The 11 groups include five from Mexico, two from Brazil, one from Japan, one from South Korea, one from Argentina and one from Venezuela.
The Mexican firms were Hylsamex SA, Imexsa, Sicartsa, Grupo Acero del Norte and Ahmsa and Grupo Siderurgica Panamericana. From Brazil Usiminas and Companhia Siderurgica Nacional have regsitered.
Japan's Kobe Steel Ltd, South Korea's Dongkuk Steel Group, Argentina's Siderar SAIC and Venezuela's Sivensa make up the rest.
The FIV said the companies will be assessed to decide whether or not they are qualified to bid for the 1.8 million tonne per year capacity company.
Among the requirements are a net worth over $250 million, proven experience in managing similar plants and a production capacity of at least one million tonnes per year.
